text: PoE/PoC operation stays weak even as report completeness recovers to 84.6%. Only 9.1% of Ituri's strategic points and 55.0% of Haut-Uele's are functional, five Haut-Uele points transmitted nothing for lack of connection, Tshopo has activated 18 of 30 planned PoC (60%), and Bas-Uele did not report.
